cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(OpenSPHCore LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 14)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(WITH_TBB OFF)
set(WITH_VDB OFF)
set(WITH_CHAISCRIPT OFF)
add_definitions(-DSPH_VERSION=0.4.1-native)
include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/core)
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "x86_64|AMD64")
  add_compile_options(-msse4.1)
endif()
add_subdirectory(core)
target_include_directories(core PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/core)
target_compile_options(core PRIVATE -Wno-deprecated-declarations)
